name: How do I choose the right contractor for my light-commercial project?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for my light-commercial project?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor for your light-commercial project, prioritize experience in similar commercial builds, strong references, and a clear communication style. Look for a contractor with a proven track record, proper licensing and insurance, and a transparent bidding process. Review their portfolio, understand their project management approach, and ensure they align with your project's goals and budget. A good contractor will also demonstrate a solid understanding of local building codes and permitting processes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with relevant experience, strong references, proper licensing, clear communication, and a transparent bidding process.
